item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 04:12 AM 16 November 2026

Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Guimaras(Jordan, Sibunag), #Iloilo(Carles, Estancia, Bingawan, BarotacViejo, SanEnrique), #Capiz(Dumalag, Sigma, Ivisan and RoxasCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Panay, Pontevedra, Panitan, Dao, Cuartero, Dumarao, MaAyon, PresidentRoxas, Pilar), #Iloilo(CityOfPassi, Lemery, SanRafael, Sara, Balasan, SanDionisio, Ajuy, Concepcion, Batad), #Guimaras(SanLorenzo and Buenavista) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
